claim_text: Every approved applicant at Maple Court automatically receives a non-repayable $1,000 cash grant.
evidence_excerpt: Maple Court provides limited move-in assistance as a no-interest loan for eligible tenants, capped at $800 and limited to documented moving expenses. Assistance is subject to available program funds and requires repayment under a written schedule.
source_page_text: Maple Court provides limited move-in assistance as a no-interest loan for eligible tenants, capped at $800 and limited to documented moving expenses. Assistance is subject to available program funds and requires repayment under a written schedule. The building contains studio and one-bedroom rental apartments. Applicants must meet posted income limits and sign a lease for a unit at Maple Court.
eligibility_conditions: Applicants must meet the posted income limits.
verification_rationale: The source describes conditional move-in assistance as a repayable loan capped at $800, not an automatic, non-repayable $1,000 cash grant. These stated terms directly contradict the claim.
applicability_requirements: Applicants must sign a lease for a unit at Maple Court.
Move-in assistance is limited to documented moving expenses and depends on available program funds.
assistance_or_support_rules: Move-in assistance is a no-interest loan capped at $800.
Assistance is limited to documented moving expenses and is subject to available program funds.
Recipients must repay the loan under a written schedule.
